question: Which mantra form is invoked to protect the upper part of the body?
premises: The root mantra begins and ends with the kūrca syllable
The root mantra consists of ten syllables
Protection is sought for the upper part
inference: The ten-syllabled root mantra, framed by kūrca, is invoked to protect the upper part.
plain_english: And may the ten-syllabled root mantra, beginning and ending with kūrca, protect the upper part.
